zh: 设置中新增版本检查入口，对照插件市场审核版本。
支持显示对应市场版本的更新说明。
en: Add a settings entry to compare the installation with the reviewed plugin directory version.
Show release notes for the corresponding directory version.

zh: 检查插件版本时显示加载动画。
在设置中显示版本号，并以 Markdown 展示市场版本的更新内容。
en: Show a loading indicator while checking the plugin version.
Display version numbers and render the marketplace release notes as Markdown in settings.

zh: 检查版本时显示加载动画，启动时自动检查并可在设置中关闭。
显示版本号与 build，并以 Markdown 展示插件市场版本的更新内容。
发现较新的市场版本时显示红点，并可复制更新命令。
en: Show a loading indicator and automatically check on startup, with an option to turn the check off.
Display version and build numbers and render the marketplace release notes as Markdown.
Show an update badge and offer a command to copy when a newer marketplace version is available.

zh: 设置中可检查市场版本、查看更新说明并复制更新命令。
支持自动检查更新，并在发现新版本时显示提示。
en: Check the directory version, read release notes and copy the update command in settings.
Check automatically and show a badge when an update is available.
